prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: neck and back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1227; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully making a left turn when your insured failed to yield the right of way and struck the driver's side of our client's vehicle. The police report and the photographs taken at the scene reflect the force of the impact and the damage to both vehicles.

As a direct result of the collision, [CLIENT_NAME] sustained neck and back strain. Our client experienced immediate pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion, and was advised by treating providers to attend physical therapy and to limit lifting and driving while recovering. Our client has missed time from work and continues to experience discomfort that interferes with daily activities.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured had a duty to exercise reasonable care and to yield when oncoming traffic was approaching, and the failure to do so caused the collision and our client's injuries. Our client has incurred medical expenses, lost wages, and general damages for pain and suffering.

We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims against your insured arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file suit without further notice.
